candidate.audio: Full-clip short high-band transient after attenuation, with sustained following speech. Use no transcript or timing hint.
candidate.correspondence: Ordered one-to-one matching with event strength and sub-picture residual. Search a shared constant offset, then at most one alternate offset over a short bounded run with matched events on both sides. Preserve ambiguous assignments.
candidate.output: Evidence of localized relative timing only. Good alignment is compatible with edited content.
candidate.video: Full-clip stateless native lip reopening after a near-closed run. Require exact picture ticks and report both source pictures. Use no target hint.

protocol.advance: At least 8 useful event pairs across four groups, at least two per sign, >=35% assessed coverage, no more than one ordinary false event, zero on unchanged/global/synchronized controls.
protocol.calibration: Fixed ambiguity margin .12. Review score is max(.22, highest ordinary eligible development score + .025).
protocol.controls: Original, local gain, mild equalization, deterministic pink-like background, both whole-track offsets, and synchronized delayed mouth and speech in matched prepared signals.
protocol.development: Previously exposed Lombard sources. Use their labels only to set the point and inspect feasibility.
protocol.edits: Move sound by five or seven native picture periods (roughly ±208 or ±292 ms) locally for 640 ms around the known burst, keeping every audio sample outside the blend unchanged. Freeze roles before scoring.
protocol.held: 12 new publisher speaker groups with two plain and two Lombard originals each. Independently qualify one acoustic/visible source event; no detector flags influence admission.
protocol.match: Estimate an acoustic onset and mouth reopening in their native clocks. Each must be within two native frames or 80 ms of its known event and relative signed error at most 80 ms.
